relations.text: VMDRとTotalCloudがOracle Cloud Infrastructureと標準で統合され、Oracle Cloud Marketplaceでも提供されている

relations.text: Container SecurityをServiceNowと統合し、脆弱性の検出から修復までを自動化している

source.label: Qualys 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Integrated Qualys’ Container Security solution with ServiceNow to automate vulnerability detection, prioritization, and remediation seamlessly through ServiceNow workflows.

relations.text: Container SecurityをServiceNowのワークフローと統合している

source.label: Qualys 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Integrated Container Security with ServiceNow to enable organizations to seamlessly detect, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities at scale using Qualys’ runtime-aware security intelligence with ServiceNow’s workflow automation.
